# pagify — US-004: Navigate generated file structure

## Goal

Browse a site whose navigation is inferred from Markdown files, with no manual nav file.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given `docs/guides/install.md` and `docs/index.md`.
2. When the site is built.
3. Then `/guides/install/` resolves to `dist/guides/install/index.html`.
4. And the sidebar lists `guides` as a group and `index.md` as the front-door link.
5. And `.md` links render as clean URLs.
